prerequisites: The student can manage a Linux and Windows server.
The student can configure the following routing protocols (RIP, OSPF, EIGRP).
The student can manage a virtualization environment.

learning_outcomes.text: At the end of this course, the student is able to install, configure and maintain complex ICT services. The student analyzes the requirements as set out by the client. The student documents this analysis and creates an overview diagram of the system. The student installs and configures the necessary components and services. The student ensures the necessary security aspects in terms of the network. The student installs and demonstrates the necessary monitoring for the system. The student delivers clear documentation so that review is possible.

At the end of this course, the student is able to communicate with third parties about large networks and services. The student is able to discuss and defend his/her analysis, design, implementation and testing method with the client, other teams and third parties.
The student independently thinks, analyzes, and implements a test setup for their network.

syllabus_topics: The student is presented with a number of ICT problems that they must solve using their already acquired knowledge and the theory from this course.
assessment_rules: The final grade is based on a 40% theory exam and 60% lab assignment. Partial transfers are possible for successful partial results of 'OS & Services Advanced: Theory' and 'OS & Services Advanced: Lab' within the academic year. Resits are available for the oral theory exam (40%) and practical exam (60%). No presentation/demonstration during lab sessions results in no points for the assignment.
